'''Maegyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was the head chef of the [[Golden Cochlea]] restaurant in the city of [[Hedrett]] and he often got [[Mothven Star Trading]] to obtain herbs and spices for him to use.
